source: JRC Global Surface Water v1.5 aggregated 1984-2024

definition.water_access_index_relative_0_100: Min-max normalised inverse distance from each grid centroid to the nearest JRC pixel classified as permanent water (seasonality=12); relative spatial rank only.
definition.candidate_water: A satellite-classified surface-water location; field verification of water volume, pumpability, legal permission, and vehicle access remains mandatory.

pupr_bore_well_candidates.definition: Distance to a PUPR-mapped bore-well candidate. It is separate from the JRC-only surface-water index and must not be treated as a confirmed fire-water source.
